title: Knowledge Representation Levels by Functional Tier Matrix
description: Given a description of a clinical knowledge artifact, the learner can classify it by both its knowledge representation level (Narrative, Semi-Structured, Structured, Executable) and its functional tier (Data, Logic, Forms/UI) using the matrix.
creator: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs
